name: Alioth
source:
A free and unrestrained travelling fortune teller who leads a band of historical heroes. Appearing before Leonhardt who was leading the Vanguard of the Empire’s forces, she offers to aid him in his efforts. She is capable of using extremely powerful and potent magic without the aid of any Tactica, and she often questions Leonhardt on various things. 
To what end, you may ask? Perhaps nobody but her may ever know.
